channel.description: Latest articles from Global Africa Network Media (globalafricanetwork.com)

item.title: Electra Mining Africa adds new outside exhibit area, showcasing top OEMs and leading component suppliers
item.description: The biennial show is set to unveil several exciting additions in 2026, among them, a new outside exhibit area located in the Arena at the Expo Centre.

item.title: Investment opportunities in the West Coast District Municipality
item.description: The West Coast District is strategically positioned on South Africa’s western coastline, offering direct access to the Atlantic Ocean and proximity to major markets.

item.title: A strategically positioned investment destination in southern Africa
item.description: Opportunities exist in key sectors of this region and its strategic location at the confluence of major logistics arterials and corridors such as the R30, N1, N6, N5, N8 and N3, makes the transportation of goods economically viable.

item.title: Investment opportunities in medical manufacturing cluster
item.description: The OR Tambo SEZ is in the process of developing a globally competitive medical manufacturing cluster that will enhance the production and export of time-sensitive products such as medicines.

item.title: The first large-scale onshore salmon operation in the Northern Cape
item.description: Southern African Atlantic Salmon (SAAS) aims to establish the first large-scale onshore Atlantic salmon farming operation in South Africa, using cutting-edge Norwegian flow-through technology.

item.title: Alternative waste treatment project seeks private sector partners (PPP)
item.description: This project presents a strategic investment opportunity in clean energy, waste management and sustainable urban infrastructure. Seeking private sector partners (PPP).

item.title: Groundbreaking technology: Shaping the future of mining
item.description: CTC Plant Company and Tempo Equipment and Attachments deliver innovative attachments that drive productivity and safety.

item.title: Showcase your products at in-cosmetics Global 2026 in Paris, France from 14-16 April 2026
item.description: Manufacturers/suppliers of essential oils, vegetable oils, botanical extracts as well as innovative cosmetic actives are invited to apply. Deadline for submission is 31 January 2026.

item.title: A secure, future-ready platform to build scalable digital enterprises
item.description: The ELIDZ is ideally positioned for BPO operators, ICT manufacturers, software developers, data service providers, and smart technology innovators seeking a cost-effective SEZ base serving both domestic and export markets.

item.title: Energy: The cornerstone of Africa’s infrastructure development
item.description: By aligning energy availability with infrastructure projects, Africa can unlock efficiencies, reduce project risks, and attract private capital for long-term, sustainable growth.
